root_cause: Browser translated already-static public EN DOM mutations and, on any failed batch, retried twice, recursively split batches into groups of 5, and sent per-string requests for all unresolved items, amplifying genuine upstream 429 into hundreds of 502/499 responses.
prevention: No provider retry fan-out: fail at first provider 429/5xx/network, stop all remaining work, hold 5-minute in-tab cooldown, preserve original/local/static content and visible error, never retranslate static public /en DOM, keep original locale links; no unapproved provider fallback.

shadow: netlify request logs after deployed exact SHA
outcome: independent actual /en page and provider request-rate monitoring

security_guardrails: No raw user data in logs
No new provider or paid fallback
No fake English text; keep build fail-closed
